_note: Evidence requirements per issue category. 'doc_types' are document classes that MAY satisfy the requirement; an auto-match is only ever marked REQUIRES_VERIFICATION — never SUFFICIENT — until a user assesses it.

requirements.label: Bank statement for the full year showing each cash deposit
requirements.client_question: Please share the complete bank statement (all pages) for the account in which cash was deposited, for the full financial year.

requirements.label: Cash book showing receipts, balances and withdrawals for deposit
requirements.client_question: Please share the cash book for the full year, showing the opening balance, daily receipts and the entries for cash deposited into the bank.

requirements.label: Deposit-wise source mapping (receipt date ≤ deposit date, cash balance available)
requirements.client_question: For each cash deposit, please list the underlying cash receipts (date, party, amount, voucher/invoice number).

requirements.label: Sales invoices / sales register for cash sales relied upon
requirements.client_question: Please provide the invoices and the sales register for every cash sale relied upon as a source of the deposits.

requirements.label: ITR and financial statements showing turnover
requirements.client_question: Please share the filed ITR acknowledgement and the audited/final financial statements for the year.

requirements.label: Sales ledger / register
requirements.client_question: Please share the sales ledger/register for the full year.

requirements.label: Invoices for each cash sale
requirements.client_question: Please share copies of all invoices for cash sales, particularly those above ₹50,000.

requirements.label: Cash book entries for the same sales
requirements.client_question: Please share the cash book entries corresponding to each cash sale.

requirements.label: GST returns reporting the outward supplies
requirements.client_question: Please share GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B for the year (if GST-registered).

requirements.label: Stock / delivery records supporting the sale
requirements.client_question: Please share stock registers, delivery challans or e-way bills for the cash sales.

requirements.label: Debtor ledger (current & prior year)
requirements.client_question: Please share the customer ledgers for the current year and the prior year, showing the opening balances.

requirements.label: Prior-year balance sheet / debtor schedule showing opening balance
requirements.client_question: Please share the prior-year balance sheet and the debtors schedule.

requirements.label: Customer balance confirmations
requirements.client_question: Please obtain written balance confirmations from each customer whose collection is relied upon.

requirements.label: Original sale invoices giving rise to the debt
requirements.client_question: Please share the original invoices that gave rise to the debtor balances.

requirements.label: Partner/member capital accounts
requirements.client_question: Please share each partner's capital account for the year.

requirements.label: Signed confirmation from each contributing partner
requirements.client_question: Please obtain a signed confirmation from each partner for the amount contributed.

requirements.label: Partner's source of funds (bank statement / cash book / ITR)
requirements.client_question: Please share each partner's personal bank statements, ITR acknowledgement and any record showing where the contributed cash came from.

requirements.label: Partnership deed (capital clause)
requirements.client_question: Please share the current partnership deed.

requirements.label: Lender confirmation (identity)
requirements.client_question: Please obtain a signed loan confirmation from the lender with their PAN and address.

requirements.label: Lender ITR / financials (creditworthiness)
requirements.client_question: Please obtain the lender's ITR acknowledgement and computation of income for the year.

requirements.label: Lender bank statement around the loan date (genuineness & source of source)
requirements.client_question: Please obtain the lender's bank statement for at least one month before and after the loan date, and an explanation of any cash deposited shortly before the transfer.

requirements.label: Loan agreement / terms, interest and TDS
requirements.client_question: Please share any loan agreement or letter setting out the terms, interest rate and repayment schedule, and details of interest paid and TDS deducted.

requirements.label: Assessee's bank statement showing receipt
requirements.client_question: Please confirm the bank account in which the loan was received.

requirements.label: Assessee's unsecured loan ledger
requirements.client_question: Please share the assessee's ledger account showing the loan received and outstanding balance.

requirements.label: Customer confirmation of advance
requirements.client_question: Please obtain written confirmation from the customer of the advance paid and its purpose.

requirements.label: Purchase order / agreement for which the advance was paid
requirements.client_question: Please share the purchase order, quotation or agreement against which the advance was received.

requirements.label: Subsequent invoice / adjustment or refund evidence
requirements.client_question: Please share the invoice against which the advance was adjusted, or evidence of refund, or explain why it remains outstanding.

requirements.label: Bank statement
requirements.client_question: Please share the complete bank statement for the year.

requirements.label: Bank book / bank ledger in the books
requirements.client_question: Please share the bank book (bank ledger) from your accounting software.

requirements.label: Credit-wise nature and party schedule
requirements.client_question: Please classify each credit in the bank statement (sale, collection, loan, advance, capital, other) with the party name.

requirements.label: Sales ledger for receipts claimed as sales
requirements.client_question: Please share the sales ledger and invoices for credits claimed to be sales receipts.

requirements.label: Form 26AS / AIS / TIS
requirements.client_question: Please download and share Form 26AS, AIS and TIS for the year.

requirements.label: Filed ITR
requirements.client_question: Please share the filed ITR and its computation.

requirements.label: Reconciliation of AIS/26AS to books
requirements.client_question: Please prepare a reconciliation of the AIS/26AS amounts to the books.

requirements.label: Bills / invoices
requirements.client_question: Please share bills/invoices for the expenses queried.

requirements.label: Expense ledger
requirements.client_question: Please share the ledger accounts for the expenses queried.

requirements.label: Payment proof (mode of payment)
requirements.client_question: Please share proof of payment showing the mode of payment.

requirements.label: Sale / purchase deed
requirements.client_question: Please share the registered sale/purchase deed.

requirements.label: Bank trail of consideration
requirements.client_question: Please share bank statements showing payment/receipt of consideration.

requirements.label: Stamp duty valuation / valuation report
requirements.client_question: Please share the stamp duty valuation and any valuation report.

requirements.label: Sales ledger / register with channel-wise totals
requirements.client_question: Please share the sales ledger/register for the year with cash and bank/other-mode totals.

requirements.label: Filed GST return summaries (GSTR-1 / GSTR-3B)
requirements.client_question: Please share the filed GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B summaries for the year.

requirements.label: Reconciliation of book sales to returns, classification-wise
requirements.client_question: Please share the reconciliation of book sales to the GST returns, classification-wise (taxable, exempt/nil-rated).

requirements.label: Sample invoices for the items queried
requirements.client_question: Please share copies of the invoices for the items queried in the notice.

requirements.label: Party-wise balance confirmations
requirements.client_question: Please obtain balance confirmations from each creditor named in the notice as at the year end.

requirements.label: Creditor ledger extracts and purchase invoices
requirements.client_question: Please share each creditor's ledger account and the purchase invoices making up the balance.

requirements.label: Subsequent settlement and payment bank entries
requirements.client_question: Please share the bank entries for payments made to these creditors after the year end.

requirements.label: Purchase invoices making up each closing balance
requirements.client_question: Please share the purchase invoices that make up each creditor's closing balance.

requirements.label: Purchase invoices and supplier details
requirements.client_question: Please share the purchase invoices and supplier details for the selected purchases.

requirements.label: Goods-received / inward register and stock records
requirements.client_question: Please share the goods-received / inward register entries and stock ledger for these purchases.

requirements.label: Transport / delivery evidence
requirements.client_question: Please share transport or delivery documents (e-way bill, docket, lorry receipt) for these purchases.

requirements.label: Payment entries and purchase-ledger account
requirements.client_question: Please share the bank entries for payment and the supplier's account in the purchase ledger.

requirements.label: Purchase-ledger account of each selected supplier
requirements.client_question: Please share the purchase-ledger account of each selected supplier for the year.

requirements.label: Supplier invoices for the additions
requirements.client_question: Please share the supplier invoices for each asset added during the year.

requirements.label: Payment evidence
requirements.client_question: Please share the bank entries for payment for each asset.

requirements.label: Delivery / installation records and date first put to use
requirements.client_question: Please share delivery/installation records and the date each asset was first put to use.

requirements.label: Asset register and depreciation computation reconciled to the return
requirements.client_question: Please share the fixed-asset register and the depreciation computation as filed with the return.

requirements.label: Fixed-asset register entries for the additions
requirements.client_question: Please share the fixed-asset register entries for the assets added during the year.

requirements.label: Documents specifically requested in the query
requirements.client_question: Please provide the documents/explanation requested in this query (see query text).
